svg.title: A sale becomes a chart only after four separate gates
svg.desc: Daily files and frequent events enter protected raw storage, pass identity and contract checks, become versioned governed data, and reach a finance chart. A separate direct-object path must be tested for bypass. Correct bars require reconciled rows, grain, freshness and access.
svg.text: From arriving sale to trusted finance chart
Each gate answers a different question.
Daily files + events; source, identity and raw lineage
Check contract, units and duplicate IDs; reject bad rows
Reconcile IDs; version output; test table and raw-object access
Label grain and freshness; match chart totals to source
A chart is a new copy: protect query results and exports too.
Conceptual route; no AWS lake or access policy tested.
